title: Balanced brackets
description:
Before loading a customer's templated config, you want a quick sanity check that its brackets match up.

Write `is_balanced(text)` that returns `True` if every `(`, `[`, and `{` is closed by the right kind of bracket in the right order. Ignore every other character.

**Example**

```
is_balanced("{users: [a, (b)]}")   # True
is_balanced("(]")                  # False
is_balanced("((")                  # False
```
hints: A Python list is a stack: `append` pushes and `pop` removes the most recent item.
Push each opening bracket. On a closing bracket, the top of the stack must be its partner.
A dict from closing bracket to opening bracket keeps the matching logic to one line. Do not forget the stack must be empty at the end.
